article.title: Reliance Industries' O2C segment faces a two-sided crude move as Brent climbs to a five-month high
article.text: Reliance Industries' oil-to-chemicals segment faces a genuinely two-sided move as Brent crude climbed to a five-month high on tightening OPEC+ supply. Analysts said the export-oriented refiner would see stronger crude-linked product realisations and inventory gains, but the same move lifts naphtha feedstock costs for its petrochemicals business, with no administered retail-pricing drag either way since the segment sells at market-linked prices.
article.note: The refiner_marketing_margin mechanism is DIRECT by registry construction (crude is simultaneously feedstock cost and realisation driver) yet its CANONICAL effect is 'mixed', never a signed direction -- this fixture pins that a genuinely two-sided company-specific story must publish as mixed (direction neutral, per DIRECTION_FROM_EFFECT) even when the mechanism is strong, direct, and the company is the article's own primary subject. A confident directional call on this exact shape is the regression this exists to catch.

companies.name: Reliance Industries
companies.mechanism: Export-oriented refining realizes market-linked product prices and books inventory gains as crude rises, while petrochemical naphtha feedstock cost rises at the same time -- the two channels are genuinely competing, not a hedge on one signed view
companies.rationale: Company-specific two-sided exposure: no administered-price drag to bias the refining side, and a real, material feedstock cost increase on the petrochemicals side

ground_truth.rationale: Reliance is the article's own subject at d1 with a company-specific, materially two-sided mechanism (real realisation/inventory gains competing against a real feedstock cost increase, no administered-price bias either way). The correct fundamental effect is mixed and the correct direction is neutral (DIRECTION_FROM_EFFECT['mixed'] == 'neutral') -- never a confident bullish or bearish call, even though the mechanism is DIRECT, HIGH materiality, and the company is the primary subject. Forcing a signed call on a genuinely two-sided company-specific story is the exact failure mode mixed_accuracy exists to catch.
